def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)

    inset = 1
    while (r1 - r0 + 1 - 2 * inset) > 3 and (c1 - c0 + 1 - 2 * inset) > 3:
        color = 2 if inset % 2 else 5
        top, bottom = r0 + inset, r1 - inset
        left, right = c0 + inset, c1 - inset
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[top][c] = color
            out[bottom][c] = color
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            out[r][left] = color
            out[r][right] = color
        inset += 1
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h0, w0 = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate the rectangular 5-colored frame.
    rows = [r for r in range(h0) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for c in range(w0))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w0) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h0))]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)

    # Paint inward concentric rectangular rings, alternating 2 and 5.
    for inset in range(1, min((r1-r0)//2, (c1-c0)//2) + 1):
        top, bottom = r0 + inset, r1 - inset
        left, right = c0 + inset, c1 - inset
        height, width = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1
        color = 2 if inset % 2 else 5

        if height <= 2 or width <= 2:
            for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
                for c in range(left, right + 1):
                    out[r][c] = color
            break

        if height == 3 and width == 3:
            break

        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[top][c] = color
            out[bottom][c] = color
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            out[r][left] = color
            out[r][right] = color

    return out
